mapper.sql: sys15_corp.sys15_corp_id AS corp_id, sys15_corp.sys15_company_id AS company_id, sys15_corp.sys15_corp_type AS corp_type, f_cdnm('CorpType', sys15_corp_type, sys15_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS corp_type_name, sys15_corp.sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name, sys15_corp.sys15_biz_no AS biz_no, sys15_corp.sys15_corp_cd AS corp_code, sys15_corp.sys15_seq AS seq, sys15_corp.sys15_use_yn AS use_yn, sys15_corp.sys15_note AS note, sys15_corp.sys15_tel AS tel, sys15_corp.sys15_addr AS addr, sys15_corp.sys15_iss_corp_cd AS iss_corp_code, ( SELECT COUNT(*) || '건' FROM sys17_corp_account WHERE sys17_corp_id = sys15_corp_id ) AS corp_account_cnt
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM sys15_corp WHERE sys15_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys15_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION SELECT emp01_person_id AS corp_id , emp01_company_id AS company_id , 'Z99' AS corp_type , '임직원' AS corp_type_name , emp01_kor_nm AS corp_name , NULL AS biz_no , NULL AS corp_code , NULL AS seq , 'true' AS use_yn , NULL AS note , emp01_mobile_telno AS tel , emp02_zip_addr AS addr , NULL AS iss_corp_code , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY emp01_person_id) || '건' AS corp_account_cnt FROM emp01_person LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_today() )) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM emp14_account a WHERE emp14_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp14_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.emp14_start_date) FROM emp14_account b WHERE b.emp14_person_id = a.emp14_person_id AND b.emp14_start_date <= f_today() ) ) emp14 ON emp14_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800') ) t WHERE COALESCE(corp_type,'9') LIKE #{corpType} AND CONCAT(corp_name, corp_code, note) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY corp_type, COALESCE(seq, 999999999), corp_name collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys15_corp (sys15_corp_id, sys15_company_id, sys15_corp_nm, sys15_corp_type, sys15_iss_corp_cd, sys15_use_yn, sys15_seq, sys15_note, sys15_corp_cd, sys15_biz_no, sys15_tel, sys15_addr) VALUES (#{req.corpId}, #{companyId}, #{req.corpName}, #{req.corpType}, #{req.issCorpCode}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.seq}, #{req.note}, #{req.corpCode}, #{req.bizNo}, #{req.tel}, #{req.addr})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys15_corp SET sys15_corp_nm = #{req.corpName}, sys15_corp_type = #{req.corpType}, sys15_iss_corp_cd = #{req.issCorpCode}, sys15_use_yn = #{req.useYn}, sys15_seq = #{req.seq}, sys15_note = #{req.note}, sys15_corp_cd = #{req.corpCode}, sys15_biz_no = #{req.bizNo}, sys15_tel = #{req.tel}, sys15_addr = #{req.addr} WHERE sys15_corp_id = #{req.corpId} AND sys15_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys15_corp (sys15_corp_id, sys15_company_id, sys15_corp_nm, sys15_corp_type, sys15_iss_corp_cd, sys15_use_yn, sys15_seq, sys15_note, sys15_corp_cd, sys15_biz_no, sys15_tel, sys15_addr) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, sys15_corp_nm, sys15_corp_type, sys15_iss_corp_cd, sys15_use_yn, sys15_seq, sys15_note, sys15_corp_cd, sys15_biz_no, sys15_tel, sys15_addr FROM sys15_corp WHERE sys15_company_id = 0
